enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running to stay cool through the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the sheet over the legs. Turn the fan dial to the on position. Close the eyes. Lie on the back. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Turn onto the left side. Pull the sheet up to the chest. Turn onto the back. Move the arm under the pillow. Turn onto the right side. Keep the eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Turn onto the left side. Remain lying on the bed. Keep the fan running.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open the eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing the legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup water in both hands. Splash water on the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Put the toothbrush back into the cup. Pick up the clothes. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Pull up the socks. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling the kettle for tea and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Open the kitchen door. Turn on the kitchen light. Walk to the counter. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Put the kettle on its base. Press the switch to boil. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Take a slice of bread. Place the bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Pick up the mug. Pour hot water into the mug. Place the tea bag into the mug. Stir with a spoon. Take the toast out of the toaster. Put the toast on a plate. Sit down at the table. Eat the toast. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Rinse the plate and mug. Place them on the drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag, checking schedule and heatwave updates on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pick up the work bag from the floor. Open the bag zipper. Put the notebook into the bag. Put the pen into the bag. Zip the bag closed. Pick up the phone from the desk. Press the power button. Unlock the screen. Open the weather app. Scroll the heatwave update. Read the forecast. Open the calendar app. Tap on the day's schedule. Scroll the list of meetings. Press the lock button. Place the phone into the bag pocket. Pick up the water bottle. Place the water bottle into the side pocket of the bag. Lift the bag onto the shoulder.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community centre, walking and taking public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the apartment door. Pull the door closed. Lock the door with the key. Walk down the stairs. Step onto the pavement. Walk along the street to the bus stop. Stop at the bus stop. Stand and wait. Take the phone out of the pocket. Check the bus arrival time on the phone. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down. Hold the bag on the lap. Stand up at the stop. Walk to the bus door. Step off the bus. Walk along the street toward the community centre. Push the entrance door open. Walk inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the community centre: coordinating program logistics, emails and partner calls
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down at the desk. Turn on the computer. Log in with the password. Open the email program. Read the new emails. Type replies on the keyboard. Click Send. Pick up the phone. Dial a partner's number. Talk on the phone about the program schedule. End the call. Put the phone down. Open the spreadsheet. Update the program logistics table. Type the participant numbers. Save the file. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Collect the printed pages. Walk back to the desk. Staple the pages together. Place the papers into a folder. Open the cabinet drawer. Put the folder inside. Close the drawer.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at a nearby cafe, resting in the shade
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the community centre. Walk along the street to the cafe. Push the cafe door open. Walk to the counter. Read the menu board. Order a sandwich and a cold drink. Pay with the card. Take the receipt. Walk to a table in the shade. Pull the chair out. Sit down. Unwrap the sandwich. Eat the sandwich. Open the bottle. Drink the water. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Place the napkin on the plate. Sit and rest. Stand up. Push the chair in. Carry the tray to the counter. Walk out of the cafe.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the community centre: running a community workshop and updating participant records
enriched_activities.desc: Walk back into the community centre. Walk to the workshop room. Move the chairs into a circle. Set the tables at the side. Open the box of materials. Place the handouts on each chair. Turn on the projector. Connect the laptop to the projector cable. Greet the participants at the door. Start the workshop. Stand in front of the group. Point at the slide. Write on the whiteboard. Answer questions. Hand out the worksheets. Walk between the tables. Collect the completed worksheets. End the workshop. Thank the participants. Turn off the projector. Disconnect the laptop. Walk to the desk. Open the participant record file. Type the attendance notes. Save the file. Stack the chairs back. Close the materials box.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the community centre during the hot afternoon
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the community centre. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the stop. Fan the face with a hand. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down. Hold the bag on the lap. Look at the phone screen. Stand up at the stop. Step off the bus. Walk along the street. Walk up the stairs. Unlock the apartment door. Push the door open. Walk inside. Close the door. Lock the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower to recover from the heatwave and changing into light clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater. Turn the shower tap to cold. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the arms. Rub the soap on the body. Rinse with water. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the hand. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body. Wrap the towel around the waist. Walk out of the shower. Put on the light shirt. Put on the shorts. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner with the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Turn on the range hood. Press the power button of the induction cooker. Place the pan on the cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables into the pan. Stir with the spatula. Add salt. Crack the eggs into the pan. Stir the food. Press the button to turn off the cooker. Pick up the plate. Scoop the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down. Eat the dinner. Drink water. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up dishes and tidying the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the plate and the pan to the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Add dish soap to the sponge. Scrub the plate. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate on the drying rack. Scrub the pan. Rinse the pan. Place the pan on the rack. Scrub the spatula. Rinse the spatula. Place the spatula on the rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter. Wipe the cutting board. Wipe the stove surface. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with the air conditioner on, watching TV and browsing phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button of the air conditioner. Press the temperature button. Sit down on the sofa. Press the TV power button with the remote. Change the channel. Put the remote on the sofa cushion. Pick up the phone. Unlock the screen. Scroll the news feed. Tap a video. Watch the TV screen. Put the phone down. Lean back on the sofa. Pick up the phone again. Scroll the messages. Reply to a message with typed text. Put the phone on the side table. Watch TV. Press the volume button. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Fill a glass with water. Walk back to the sofa. Sit down. Drink water. Place the glass on the side table.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review tomorrow's program schedule and reply to messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down at the desk. Turn on the desk lamp. Press the computer power button. Open the calendar program. Read tomorrow's program schedule. Type notes on the keyboard. Open the message app. Read the new messages. Type replies. Press Send. Save the schedule file. Close the programs. Press the computer power button to shut down. Pick up the phone. Set the alarm for the morning. Put the phone on the bedside table. Turn off the desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wash the hands with soap. Rinse the hands. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Spit into the sink. Put the brush back into the cup. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Going to sleep with the fan on for the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the fan. Press the fan speed button. Turn off the ceiling light. Pull back the sheet. Sit down on the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the sheet over the body. Close the eyes. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow. Turn onto the left side. Lie on the back. Keep the eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Keep the fan running. Remain lying on the bed.
